summary: Acer 16 Predator Neo with Intel Core i9-14900HX processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 graphics card, and 32GB DDR5 RAM is experiencing frequent crashes during gaming and 3D software usage, resulting in blue screens with error codes such as SYSTEM SERVICE EXCEPTION. The issue started after playing Spider-Man 2 (pirated) with high VRAM usage.
detected_fault: Potential overheating of the RTX 4070 graphics card due to thermal throttling, possibly caused by driver issues or inadequate cooling system.
suggested_solution: Run a thorough stress test (e.g., Prime95, OCCT) to identify potential overheating issues and update NVIDIA drivers to the latest version (528.50).
